result.brief: 提出 ACG-JEPA 辅助目标，用冻结 VGGT 几何特征作为预测目标，在时序混合前对共享视觉嵌入施加动作条件几何潜空间监督，实现世界-动作联合建模。
result.reason: Introduces ACG-JEPA, a JEPA-style predictive architecture with geometric latent targets for action-conditioned world-action modeling; representation contribution, though robot policy is the main application.
